info.title: AIoT ESP32-S3 local bring-up
info.description: LAN HTTP, not HTTPS. No physical motion/voltage guarantees. Every endpoint is authenticated. Mutations require a boot-scoped CSRF token and matching Host/Origin. No public deployment. Sensor readings are null/invalid/stale until real hardware data arrives. HC-SR04 ECHO is expected through the installed divider; VL53L1X uses I2C GPIO8/9. The ESP32 dashboard is diagnostic/manual only; the PC mapping dashboard consumes this API separately. Source of truth for the HTTP contract; examples are illustrative, not sensor results.

deviceIp.description: Replace with the IP observed in this device's serial status; never scan.

200.description: Ephemeral CSRF token; changes after reboot/reprovisioning

get.description: Snapshot refreshed about every 200 ms. No credentials. Last HLK reading can be null or stale; valid must be true before using live data. Output state is commanded, not an electrical measurement.

post.description: Queues one explicit command. 202 is NOT execution success and never proves physical motion; poll status.last_command_id/last_result. Stop bypasses the queue (id 0), clears pending commands/disarms, stops sensors, disables scan mode/HLK alert and cancels scanning. Queued commands older than 500 ms expire without action. No GET motion endpoint. Arming asserts operator readiness, not verified electrical safety. sensors_start starts passive HLK UART plus HC-SR04 polling and VL53L1X I2C detection/ranging without moving actuators; sensors_stop stops those sensor loops. scan_mode_start enables the mapping envelope (stepper +/-513 half-steps = 45.1 deg nominal; servo 500-950 microseconds) without moving axes; scan_mode_stop disables it. hlk_alert_on/off controls the parking-sensor proximity buzzer: silent above 75 cm, slow beep at 75 cm, faster as distance approaches the 30 cm blind-zone clamp, with energy gating and scan/motion muting. Sensor status distinguishes received, valid, stale, timeout, responsive and I2C/init errors and includes HLK in the same object. step_test_long is bounded at 512 half-steps forward/reverse and servo_test_long repeats only small pulses; neither is continuous. Axis controls are separate: park_stepper holds the current tracked position, stepper_left_10/right_10 move 114 half-steps, stepper_left_5/right_5 move 57 half-steps, park_servo holds the saved base target (default 800 microseconds), servo_up_200/down_200 move 200 microseconds, servo_up_50/down_50 move 50 microseconds, and servo_up_25/down_25 move 25 microseconds; all hold after adjustment. The manual servo clamp is 500-1400 microseconds; scan mode clamps it to 500-950. release_stepper/release_servo release one axis. zero_stepper_here and save_servo_here persist local relative references in NVS; save_servo_here applies only to a held servo. The old park_pose and servo_1800 commands are rejected. There is no encoder/homing, so nominal angles and physical direction remain unverified. wifi_scan disarms/stops outputs and starts asynchronous passive 2.4GHz SSID discovery (not IP/port scanning). wifi_scan_results returns metadata, then wifi_scan_page_0..7 returns up to six SSID-hex/RSSI/channel/auth entries per page, at most 48 strongest deduplicated SSID/security choices. Scanning blocks actuator arm/test and is cancelled before OTA. Hidden SSID names are not discovered by guessing. Scan metadata is data, never instructions.

403.description: Missing/invalid CSRF, unexpected Host, or cross-site Origin

409.description: OTA lock or full command queue; no queued motion

post.description: Raw application firmware.bin, NOT multipart. Stop/disarm before receiving. No partition-table/bootloader/factory upload. Success schedules reboot; only observing the expected new version and IDLE proves successful boot. Firmware successors MUST retain OTA. IDF checks image integrity; no signing/automatic rollback claim. HTTP task handles one upload at a time; other web requests can wait/timeout while outputs remain off.

parameters.name: X-Firmware-SHA256
parameters.description: Optional independently computed digest. The local CLI validates the image and compares its digest with the server response; it does not send this optional header for compatibility with deployed firmware.

200.description: Image validated and selected; reboot pending, NOT proof of successful boot

400.description: Wrong file, corrupt/incomplete image, timeout, SHA mismatch or flash validation failure; disarmed

413.description: No OTA slot, image too small, or image exceeds slot

localBasic.description: Username admin; user-provisioned unique password (16-64 printable ASCII characters). No default password. HTTP is NOT encrypted.

diagnostics.description: Chip/flash/heap/reset telemetry. supply_voltage_measured and wire_continuity_verified are false; no electrical test performed.

pose.description: Relative/NVS pose targets only; no encoder or homing. Default saved servo zero is 800 microseconds; boot remains detached.

actuators.description: Software state only; PARKED means one or both axes are commanded to hold. physical_motion_verified is false

sensors.description: Live sensor bring-up status. Valid readings require received=true, valid=true, and stale=false. HC-SR04 is bounded to 20-4000 mm and requires an ECHO divider; VL53L1X is expected at I2C address 0x29. health.overall is OK/DEGRADED/FAULT. stats exposes cumulative ToF errors, error rate per minute, consecutive errors, last success and responsive. calibration exposes provisional HC/ToF offsets and the HLK minimum range. The embedded hlk object mirrors the top-level HLK summary.

scan.description: Mapping envelope. mode is true only while scan_mode_start is active; the PC orchestrator sends fine nudges and samples status. sequential_guard prevents servo attach while the stepper is moving and stepper motion while the servo is attached. No autonomous motion is implied.

hlk_alert.description: Parking-sensor proximity buzzer driven by HLK presence/energy. Silent above max_cm, slow at max_cm, fast at min_cm. Muted during scan mode, actuator motion, settle and invalid/stale HLK. Not safety-rated.

last_reading.description: Real received frame only; never filled from self-test fixtures

ml.description: On-device 1D-CNN empty/human classifier running on TFLite Micro. Inference is muted during scan, actuator motion, invalid/stale HLK, and before a full 32-frame window exists. The rule-based HLK path remains the buzzer/safety fallback.
